description: This file contains test functions related to RFC feature enabling, including functions to retrieve firmware version, parse ini files, modify configuration URLs, and perform specific tests on RFC manager behavior when handling certain URL responses.

methods.name: str|None get_rfc_old_FW()
methods.description: Retrieves the old RFC firmware version from a specified file, returning the version string or None if unavailable.

methods.name: tuple[str|None,str|None] get_tr181_file_key_value()
methods.description: Extracts key and value from the TR181 INI configuration file, returning a tuple or (None, None) if not found.

methods.name: None modify_rfc_url(new_url: str)
methods.description: Modifies or creates the RFC configuration properties file to set the 'RFC_CONFIG_SERVER_URL' to a new value.

methods.name: None test_rfcMgr_xconf_304_communication()
methods.description: Test function that updates the RFC URL to a 304 test URL, runs a binary, checks logs for expected 304 error messages, and restores the URL.
